title: New York City green-taxi trips in 2025
publisher: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission
license_or_access_terms: NYC Open Data terms; attribution retained
deterministic_selection_rule: All 12 green-taxi months in 2025, full rows, with zone lookup/geography and native dictionary.

measurement_dates.description: All 12 calendar months of 2025, retained as the agency's current frozen snapshot.
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: TLC provider-submitted administrative records; data may contain reporting errors and agency/provider processing. Monthly files are retained whole, including flagged, implausible or incomplete records.
known_analyses_and_limitations: TLC trip data have extensive prior literature. Fare totals and trip durations have definitional components; memorizing those does not demonstrate scientific discovery. Anonymous trips do not identify individual travelers, and provider/zone/time effects matter.
